name: Salon (Editorial)
tagline: A warm, editorial template for hair salons — book online from day one.
description: An upscale, editorial hair-salon site — a warm-ivory palette, a brass primary and a high-contrast serif display, with soft-lit photography carrying the page. Installs a working booking flow: a real service menu (cuts, colour, balayage), three stylists you book by name with their own hours, and a colour-deposit policy. Ships as "Maison Élan", a calm three-chair studio.
